newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea works on steps to boost stock market.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea works on steps to boost stock market.

text.p: South Korea's Finance and Economy Ministry is working on steps to boost the Seoul stock market, a ministry official said on Wednesday.
"It is true that Deputy Prime Minister Han Seung-soo yesterday ordered preparatory steps to stabilise the stock market," said Kwon Tae-shin, a ministry director.
"We are considering taking various steps, including those recommended by the securities industry," Kwon said.

Another ministry official said the government was considering increasing the capital of the Korea Fund, an offshore fund specialising in South Korean equities, in the first quarter of this year. He gave no details.
Ministry officials have said the government plans to increase the fund by $200 million within this year. The fund is now capitalised at $380 million.
